dz: 君士坦丁七世是智者利奥六世的八岁私生子,在由牧首尼古拉斯·米斯提科斯(Nicholas Mystikos)为首的由君士坦丁的叔叔亚历山大在临终前任命的七人委员会摄政下,成为了拜占庭帝国名义上的统治者.
de: Constantine VII, the eight-year-old illegitimate son of Leo VI the Wise, becomes nominal ruler of the Byzantine Empire under the regency of a seven-man council headed by Patriarch Nicholas Mystikos, appointed by Constantine's uncle Alexander on his deathbed.
